parameters.query:
INSERT INTO bookings.recurring_rules
  (tenant_id, membership_id, room_id, day_of_week,
   start_time, end_time, rate_per_session, frequency, end_date, active)
VALUES
  ($1, $2::uuid, $3::uuid, $4::int,
   $5::time, $6::time,
   NULLIF($7, '')::numeric,
   COALESCE(NULLIF($8,''), 'weekly'),
   NULLIF($9,'')::date,
   TRUE)
RETURNING
  id AS rule_id, membership_id, room_id, day_of_week,
  start_time::text, end_time::text, rate_per_session,
  frequency, end_date::text, active;

options.queryReplacement:
={{ [
  parseInt($('Webhook: Add Recurring Rule').first().json.body?.tenant_id || '0'),
  $('Webhook: Add Recurring Rule').first().json.body?.membership_id || '',
  $('Webhook: Add Recurring Rule').first().json.body?.room_id || '',
  parseInt($('Webhook: Add Recurring Rule').first().json.body?.day_of_week ?? '1'),
  $('Webhook: Add Recurring Rule').first().json.body?.start_time || '09:00',
  $('Webhook: Add Recurring Rule').first().json.body?.end_time || '11:00',
  String($('Webhook: Add Recurring Rule').first().json.body?.rate_per_session || ''),
  $('Webhook: Add Recurring Rule').first().json.body?.frequency || 'weekly',
  $('Webhook: Add Recurring Rule').first().json.body?.rule_end_date || ''
] }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO bookings.customer_interactions
  (customer_id, customer_name, customer_email, customer_phone,
   booking_id, booking_date, room_name,
   subject, interaction_type, notes, timestamp, staff_member, tenant_id)
VALUES
  ($1::uuid, $2, $3, '',
   NULL, NULL, NULL,
   'Recurring rule added to membership',
   'membership',
   $4,
   NOW(), $5, $6)
RETURNING id;

options.queryReplacement:
={{ [
  $('Webhook: Add Recurring Rule').first().json.body?.customer_id || '',
  $('Webhook: Add Recurring Rule').first().json.body?.customer_name || '',
  $('Webhook: Add Recurring Rule').first().json.body?.customer_email || '',
  'Rule: day ' + ($('Webhook: Add Recurring Rule').first().json.body?.day_of_week ?? '') + ' ' + ($('Webhook: Add Recurring Rule').first().json.body?.start_time || '') + '-' + ($('Webhook: Add Recurring Rule').first().json.body?.end_time || '') + ' (' + ($('Webhook: Add Recurring Rule').first().json.body?.frequency || 'weekly') + ')',
  $('Webhook: Add Recurring Rule').first().json.body?.performed_by || 'Staff',
  parseInt($('Webhook: Add Recurring Rule').first().json.body?.tenant_id || '0')
] }}
